description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'SugarSoapService' that extends 'SugarWebService'. It serves as a base class for SOAP services in the SuiteCRM system, including properties for SOAP version, namespace, and implementation details, as well as abstract methods for registering functions and types. It also contains methods to retrieve configuration details such as URL, version, namespace, and implementation class.

classes.name: SugarSoapService
classes.description: An abstract class for SOAP services in SuiteCRM, providing foundational properties and methods for SOAP web service implementations.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Abstract method to register functions exposed as services with specified input and output parameter definitions.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Abstract method to register complex types for SOAP communication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and sets observers.

methods.name: setObservers
methods.description: Sets the soap server object on all registered observers.

methods.name: getSoapVersion
methods.description: Returns the SOAP version in use.

methods.name: getNameSpace
methods.description: Returns the namespace used for the SOAP service.

methods.name: getRegisteredImplClass
methods.description: Returns the implementation class name for the SOAP service.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the server object associated with this SOAP service.
